_about: Conversation cases for the Aivy agent playbook. Each case gives the user's message and what a well-behaved agent does with the tools: the order it must follow (`expect`, a subsequence), tools it must not call (`forbid`), and whether the turn must end in a question (`confirm`) rather than a write. Feed a transcript's tool-call list to evals/check.py.

cases.user: Sell at the best prices tonight, keep 20%.
cases.note: The first turn proposes; the write waits for a yes.

cases.user: Charge at 5 kW to 90% for the next two hours.
How much did it make yesterday?
cases.note: No arithmetic from curves and prices; the earnings tool does it.

cases.user: Make Ai+ a bit more aggressive on exports.

cases.note: Must read what Sigenergy needs (a system id) from the tool, then ask for it.

cases.user: Serial A2340000001, NMI 2001234567, yes connect it.

cases.note: A read key: explain that a control key is needed; no write attempt.

cases.user: Watch the battery and tell me when it hits 80%.
cases.note: One reading, then explain it does not refresh faster than a minute; offer to check later.
